OUTPUT.description: Folder that transcript writes run-record.json and transcript.jsonl to.

OSF_DATA.description: Folder where run records every session as sessions/<session ID>.jsonl and Codex keeps its settings, logins and sessions, in codex/.

OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.description: Resource attributes of the run as key=value pairs, set by the launcher, for example osf.run.id=…,osf.work_item.id=…,osf.factory.version=…. run keeps them with each session; transcript writes them into the run record.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: The service.name of the run record. Default: harness-codex.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the OpenAI Responses API that Codex calls, ending in /v1, for example the inference gateway.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: The key Codex sends to the model API, for example a gateway key or a placeholder that the egress proxy replaces.

OPENAI_MODEL.description: The model Codex asks for, for example gpt-5.5. Default: Codex's default model.
